description: Reads where a Live request stands (one a request_* tool, inbox_reply, site_promote, site_rebuild or replay_relay with env live, a moderation tool with env live, domain_site on a Live app or request_server_key asked) — it changes nothing (approving it in the browser is what carries it out). status: pending (waiting for the founder), running (approved; Gemmein is carrying it out), unconfirmed (started and may already have gone through; still being confirmed — never ask again on it), done (with what happened: the door's own answer — a domain's DNS records, the site's address, the customer reached), failed (why: either nothing changed — when the approval wasn't used up the founder can press Try again on the approval page once the cause is fixed, the plan paid for example — or, when its approval was used, that it may have gone through and where the founder checks; never ask again on that), refused (denied, cancelled or revoked) or expired. wait: true waits up to 40 seconds and answers the moment it is done, failed, refused or expired (a failed one whose approval was used says it may have gone through — never nothing changed) — call it again with wait: true while it is still pending, rather than asking the founder to say when they have approved. attempts lists every carry-out of the approval — its number, when it ran, how it ended and why, and who started it (the Approve, or a Try again and by whom).

wait.description: true: wait up to 40 seconds for the outcome

title: Where a Live request stands
